# slava.it.com

> 3815 tracked public community posts from 31 Facebook groups, linked to 83 UK projects (65 wind, solar and storage; 11 pylons and grid; 7 AI data centres). Posts are archived public group posts, not independently verified.

Counts are generated from the discussions index on 2026-10-18. Projects with at least two linked posts have a page. The discussions index holds 3,816 records; these pages cover 3,815 because 1 record is excluded from them.

## Hubs
- [Pylons and grid transmission](https://slava.it.com/pylons-grid/index.md): 4 projects, 6 posts; latest 2026-10-14
- [AI and data centres](https://slava.it.com/data-centres/index.md): 7 projects, 38 posts; latest 2026-10-16
- [Wind, solar and storage](https://slava.it.com/renewables-wind/index.md): 27 projects, 67 posts; latest 2026-10-15
